procedure: Verify session identity, active-document state, idle status, and non-overwrite policy.
Invoke exactly one new-blank-design command and wait for the new document to become active.
Observe the unsaved marker and document identity; do not add bodies or run a geometry check.
rejection_rules: Reject when user work might be overwritten or a new-document transition is not provable.
Do not save, load, or execute a script.
